lines.text: A flower once cost more than a house.

parts.tts: A flower once cost more than a house.
parts.heard: A flower once cost more than a house.

parts.tts: Holland, the sixteen thirtys. Everyone wanted tulips.

lines.text: The rarest ones had wild flame stripes... caused by a virus.

parts.tts: The rarest ones had wild flame stripes...
parts.heard: The rarest ones had wild flame stripes.

lines.text: People traded bulbs still in the ground... on paper... in taverns.

parts.tts: People traded bulbs still in the ground...
parts.heard: People traded bulbs still in the ground.

lines.text: One bulb reportedly sold for 10,000 guilders.

parts.tts: One bulb reportedly sold for ten thousand guilders.
parts.heard: One bulb reportedly sold for 10,000 guilders.

lines.text: A craftsman made about 300 a year.

parts.tts: A craftsman made about three hundred a year.
parts.heard: a craftsman made about 300 a year.

lines.text: Then, in February 1637... the market crashed.
But a historian who checked the records... couldn't find anyone who went bankrupt.
